name: Nanjou Shinzou
source:
Likes: Things that are good for the body
Hobby: Reading

The protagonist's grandfather and the owner of the "Yorozu Ayakashi-ya".
He's a kind person, but he can be cruel towards youkai type things.
He has complicated feelings about his granddaughter.
